choose.when: SELECT CASE WHEN i.current_version_id IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN i.kind='NOTE' THEN '未发布笔记' ELSE '未发布概念' END ELSE v.title END AS title,i.kind AS subtype,i.status FROM knowledge_item i LEFT JOIN knowledge_version v ON v.owner_id=i.owner_id AND v.item_id=i.id AND v.id=i.current_version_id AND v.version_number=i.version_number WHERE i.owner_id=#{owner} AND i.id=#{id} AND (i.current_version_id IS NULL OR v.id IS NOT NULL)
SELECT title,kind AS subtype,status FROM preparation_item WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT file_name AS title,kind AS subtype,status FROM material_attachment WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}

SELECT v.title,v.question_type AS subtype,q.status FROM question q JOIN question_version v ON v.owner_id=q.owner_id AND v.question_id=q.id AND v.id=q.current_version_id AND v.version_number=q.version_number WHERE q.owner_id=#{owner} AND q.id=#{id}
SELECT title,kind AS subtype,status FROM question_collection WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT title,mode AS subtype,status FROM training_session WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}

SELECT v.title,v.baseline_kind AS subtype,r.status FROM review_recollection r JOIN review_recollection_version v ON v.owner_id=r.owner_id AND v.recollection_id=r.id AND v.id=r.current_version_id AND v.version_number=r.version_number WHERE r.owner_id=#{owner} AND r.id=#{id}

SELECT v.title,v.card_kind AS subtype,c.status FROM memory_card c JOIN memory_card_version v ON v.owner_id=c.owner_id AND v.card_id=c.id AND v.id=c.current_version_id AND v.version_number=c.version_number WHERE c.owner_id=#{owner} AND c.id=#{id}
SELECT title,purpose AS subtype,status FROM ai_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT title,kind AS subtype,'AVAILABLE' AS status FROM knowledge_board WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT title,'INTERVIEW' AS subtype,status FROM interview_event WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
SELECT title,'PREPARATION_TASK' AS subtype,status FROM preparation_task WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND id=#{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS title,NULL AS subtype,NULL AS status WHERE FALSE

mapper.select: SELECT visited_at FROM recent_visit WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND target_kind=#{kind} AND target_id=#{id}
SELECT visited_at FROM knowledge_organization WHERE owner_id=#{owner} AND item_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recent_visit (owner_id,target_kind,target_id,visited_at) VALUES (#{owner},#{kind},#{id},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visited_at=GREATEST(visited_at,#{now})
